ruleDefinitions.name: Verclsid.exe Runs COM Object
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when verclsid.exe is used to run COM object via GUID

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\verclsid\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "verclsid\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/S.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/C.*")))
